rules.note: CAP-73: an account created by XLM sent through the native Stellar Asset Contract gets no account_created effect; the effects transform handles only SAC events for contract calls.
CAP-73: a trustline created by the Stellar Asset Contract's trust() gets no trustline_created effect.

export_token_transfer builds the processor for unified events only, which rejects any transaction whose meta is not v4: ledgers with TransactionMeta v1 to v3, such as those stellar-core older than 23.0 emits. Stellar's public archive serves old ledgers with v4 meta, so exports from it are not affected.

match.error_contains: error reading from unified events stream, expected version 4 got 3

rules.note: A revocation that redeems pool shares in several pools gets one liquidity_pool_revoked effect: getLiquidityPoolAndProductDelta(nil) returns the first pool change only. Horizon's effects processor has the same call.

A pool-share trustline removed by an authorization revocation gets no trustline_removed effect; only ChangeTrust emits it, in stellar-etl and in Horizon. The effects-model counterpart of stellar/wallet-backend#817.

export_token_transfer turns a text or hash memo into a muxed destination with ID 0: to_muxed is an M address although the CAP-67 event's to_muxed_id is a memo, not an ID. Rule written after reading the issue.
